page.overview:
Who is Nine-Tails?

The Nine-Tails (Kurama) is the most powerful tailed beast, sealed into Naruto Uzumaki and later allied with him against greater threats.

Also known as: Kurama, Kyubi, Nine-Tailed Fox, Kyuubi.
